ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels covering the central ventral surface versus 15% low-intensity black pixels localized along the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area spanning the center of both lobes. A thick, continuous black border (~10-20 pixels deep) follows the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Sparse black and brown focal spots are mapped across the white field, notably on the medial sections of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle estimated at 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the visible vertical fluke extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge; approximately 14 distinct peaks on the left lobe and 12 on the right lobe, with pixel amplitudes varying from 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning into a slight upward concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular yellowish-brown pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the mid-section of the left lobe; dense, high-contrast, irregular white/grey clusters indicative of barnacle colonies are fixed at the outer tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; one significant diagonal rake mark on the upper right lobe and several smaller near-horizontal streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization at both distal tips causing significant contour irregularity; multiple small, dark puncture-style scars visible on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated dark horizontal pigmentation marker or smudge is visible just above the water line near the central axis of the fluke's ventral surface.
